judge_justification: The response identifies only 2 of the 8 correct GAMA-Bench scenarios (Guess 2/3 of the Average and El Farol Bar) and replaces the rest with unrelated classic games. It also gives incorrect category groupings; the reference categories are Cooperative Games, Betraying games, and Sequential games, not Cooperative/Competitive/Mixed-motive.
